annotations.title: When can I renew my visa / residence card in Japan? Window, last day, special period, fee

description: Applies ISA's renewal rules as of 2026-11-08 (在留期間更新許可申請 16-3, 特例期間, 在留カードの有効期間の更新申請, 特定在留カード Q&A, 2026-10-01 fee table). expiryDate required (period-of-stay expiry; for holder permanent / hsp2 the card's validity expiry). holder: fixed | permanent | hsp2. currentPeriodMonths (default 12; under 6 removes the 3-month rule), expectedGrantMonths (fee band), appliedDate (turns on the special period), birthDate (under-16 card rule, next card validity), cardIssueDate, method counter | online, wantSpecialCard, today. Returns verdict (too_early | open | urgent | pending | special_period | expired), summary, windowOpens, lastDay, daysLeft, specialPeriodEnd, fee {band, feeJPY, processingFeeJPY, totalJPY}, card16, nextCardValidity, processing, earlyExceptions, deadlines, actions, warnings, sources, disclaimer. Use for 'when can I renew my visa in Japan', '在留期間更新 いつから', '特例期間 いつまで', 'visa expired while renewal pending', '永住者 在留カード 更新 いつから', 'Japan visa renewal fee 2026'. Educational, not immigration or legal advice; not affiliated with ISA.

currentPeriodMonths.description: Length of the current period of stay in months (default 12).

expectedGrantMonths.description: Period you expect ISA to grant, for the fee (default = current).

expiryDate.description: Period-of-stay expiry (or card expiry for permanent / hsp2), YYYY-MM-DD.

holder.description: fixed (any status with a period of stay, default) | permanent | hsp2.

wantSpecialCard.description: Wants the 特定在留カード (card + My Number).
